main_body: Two stacked logs seen from the side, with light round cut ends on the left and long dark brown bodies running right
top_band: none: the column at x=7 reads outline, then light end-grain rows 4-8, then dark body. The column at x=11 goes from a 1-row mid-brown line (row 4) straight to dark brown, with no lighter horizontal surface
evidence: The drawing is a profile of logs. The light areas are the vertical end-grain discs facing west, not a horizontal surface seen from above. The log bodies are uniformly dark with no lighter top band and no step to a separate front face. At x=11 the only lighter pixel is a 1-row line (L=106), and rows 5-13 stay dark (L 15-47). There is no horizontal surface read from above, so this is a side elevation like the guide's red side-elevation chair.

style.evidence: The outline is a tinted dark brown (0% neutral). The end-grain discs have a few light steps and rings, and there are no flat-fill areas. The piece is far thinner than the references on the measured facts: 9 distinct colours against 38-40, and 9 colours per tile against 17-20. The log bodies are mostly one dark brown with little grain or per-log highlighting, which is shallower than the Beodeul pieces.
